changeSet.sql: WITH NumberedTrucks AS ( SELECT truck_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY truck_id) AS rn FROM PalletTrucks ) MERGE INTO Rentals AS target USING ( SELECT src.OldID, t.truck_id as tid, src.sd, src.ed, src.dr, src.tc, src.rs FROM (VALUES (1, 1, '2023-01-10', '2023-01-20', 120.00, 1200.00, 'Returned'), (2, 2, '2023-02-01', '2023-02-10', 150.00, 1350.00, 'Returned'), (3, 3, '2023-03-05', '2023-03-15', 100.00, 1000.00, 'Returned'), (4, 4, '2023-04-01', NULL, 200.00, NULL, 'Active'), (5, 5, '2023-05-01', '2023-05-08', 90.00, 630.00, 'Returned'), (6, 6, '2023-06-01', NULL, 160.00, NULL, 'Active'), (7, 7, '2023-07-15', '2023-07-25', 110.00, 1100.00, 'Returned'), (8, 8, '2023-08-10', '2023-08-20', 95.00, 950.00, 'Returned'), (9, 9, '2023-09-01', NULL, 175.00, NULL, 'Active'), (10, 10, '2023-10-05', '2023-10-15', 125.00, 1250.00, 'Returned'), (11, 11, '2023-11-01', '2023-11-10', 130.00, 1170.00, 'Returned'), (12, 12, '2023-11-20', NULL, 145.00, NULL, 'Active'), (13, 13, '2023-12-01', '2023-12-05', 100.00, 500.00, 'Returned'), (14, 14, '2024-01-02', NULL, 180.00, NULL, 'Active'), (15, 15, '2024-01-10', NULL, 160.00, NULL, 'Active') ) AS src(OldID, truck_index, sd, ed, dr, tc, rs) -- Facem JOIN cu tabelul real de PalletTrucks folosind indexul generat JOIN NumberedTrucks t ON src.truck_index = t.rn ) AS src ON 1=0 WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (truck_id, start_date, end_date, daily_rate, total_cost, return_status) VALUES (src.tid, src.sd, src.ed, src.dr, src.tc, src.rs);
